case_number: Civil Appeal No. 1882 of 2023; Civil Appeal No. 1883 of 2023; Civil Appeal No. 1884 of 2023

parties.petitioner: The State of Uttar Pradesh & Ors.

summary: Selection process vs regulatory amendment; approval of DIOS mandatory, no deemed appointment; selection not final without DIOS confirmation; vacancies not governed by pre-amendment rules; vested rights not accrued to candidates; dismissal of appointment upheld; impugned High Court orders set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Uttar Pradesh Reasonable Intermediate Education Act, 1921, s.16-FF(3), s.16-FF(4), s.16-E
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgments set aside; DIOS orders upheld; selection process must comply with amended regulations; candidates not entitled to appointment.
